Name: True Forest Spirits
Author: DoJiMoDa
Description:
Here they are the true Forest Spirits. 
The Junimos are replaced with Hedgehogs. Yes.. every Junimo everywhere. 
I took the Hedgehog sprite from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52928861]froststar11[/url]´s awesome Hedgehog mod.
And for a statue, I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/20928794]vamoosi[/url]´s Echidnae Mod.

I also want to thank the very talented  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41636035]JazzMinK[/url]. Without her help, I wouldn't have finished this at all.
She Contributed the Junimoplush and a lot of support for my first mod. So if you like my Mod check out her stuff it is awesome.

Manifest.Name: Forest Spirits
Manifest.Description: Junimos are hedgehogs now. Replacement for the Junimo Hut. A shorter, rockier little home for the little guys.
